semantics: Original source bytes, indexed source/row/member hashes and selected editions remain immutable.
Reviewed mapping produces a derived FHIR collection and retains every original directory input and mapping disposition.
Selection records stated status, schedules, capacity units/timestamps and operator decisions. No directory capacity is reserved.
Clinical Task/ServiceRequest owner/performer changes occur only through explicit original-resource bindings; status, consent, response and outcome remain their original values.
Complete workspace receiving retains the same original UUID, registry, indices, captures, inherited Gravity source and every recorded original file.
Original source and edition IDs, logical JSON number tokens and member bytes are unchanged.
HSDS JSON assertions follow the exact retained canonical schemas; unknown properties are allowed unless a selected source schema says otherwise.
Tabular cells are interpreted only for checking their original compiled data-package declarations; interpreted values never replace original cells.

FHIR assessment records cardinality, selected primitive/fixed/pattern and reference observations from the exact retained snapshots. Unsupported slices, invariants, external bases and terminology are reported as unevaluated requirements.
Must Support and narrative semantic obligations remain review requirements, not invented missing-field cardinalities.
Format annotation and additional format assertions are separate operator selections.
No result is a blanket certification. A reviewed receiving disposition retains all findings and coverage limitations.
Comparison reports complete rule-outcome counts and row populations, without silently matching entities from different sources.
Whole editable export includes every assessment index, finding, rule, report and original subject.
Accept-for-receiving requires an explicit accepted-deviation or not-applicable disposition for every error; grouped decisions freeze every matched original finding ID. Findings are never removed.
The unchanged OperatingPlan model owns complete history validation, historical drafts, saved revisions, explicit copies and exact prefix-history receiving.
Prepared and saved procedure records are immutable. Only saved records participate in the per-plan head chain; a reviewed preparation retains its exact accepted input and original source basis.
Procedure editing and export do not execute commands, acquire provider data, reserve services or send messages.
Complete editable receiving includes every procedure history, native basis, original catalogue and accepted input; receiver-local import receipts retain their original Directory semantics.
Corrections bind ordered edits to exact original HSDS row, resource and member hashes; JSON numeric tokens and CSV physical cell positions remain source-native.

A preview creates complete derived sources, a separate candidate edition and its comparison. Explicit acceptance retains that exact candidate without replacing a mutable head or changing original provider data.
Complete correction plan inputs, before/after changes, source lineage and native review graph travel with complete editable workspace receiving.
